svg.title: Toolbox — tools I build with
svg.desc: Animated grid of tools by category. ML & models: Donut, Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, Qwen3, Embeddings, Rerankers, OCR, NumPy, Model serving: vLLM, AWS SageMaker, GPU inference, Amazon S3, IAM Roles Anywhere, Prometheus, Backend & data: Python, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Pydantic, JSON Schema, uv, Cloud & infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, Docker, k3s, DigitalOcean, AWS, MinIO, Security & supply chain: Linkerd mTLS, OpenBao, cert-manager, Kyverno, Sigstore Cosign, SBOM, SLSA, GitHub Actions, Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS.

svg.text: From fine-tuning and serving models to the backends and infrastructure around them.
